title: Mathematical Programming in Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence: A Unified Taxonomy of Models and Applications
abstract: arXiv:2609.07254v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mathematical programming provides a common language for many decisions embedded in modern machine-learning (ML) and artificial-intelligence (AI) systems: selecting retrieval context, routing tokens, allocating inference compute, fitting structured predictors, protecting against distribution shift, and balancing competing objectives. However, the relevant literature is fragmented across optimization, information retrieval, recommendation, natural-language processing, computer vision, and learning theory. This paper organizes various applications under common mathematical programming paradigms: linear, quadratic, binary and mixed-integer, conic, bilevel, multi-objective, inverse, distributionally robust, submodular, and min--max optimization. We normalize the models with a mostly unified notation and, for every application, identify inputs, decision variables, a principal formulation, structural properties, solution strategies, and limit

translated_title: 机器学习与人工智能中的数学规划：模型与应用的统一分类体系
translated_abstract: 数学规划为嵌入在现代机器学习（ML）与人工智能（AI）系统中的众多决策提供了一种共同语言，例如：选择检索上下文、令牌路由、分配推理计算资源、拟合结构化预测器、抵御分布偏移以及平衡相互冲突的目标。然而，相关文献分散于优化、信息检索、推荐系统、自然语言处理、计算机视觉和学习理论等多个领域。本文将各类应用归纳于共同的数学规划范式之下：线性规划、二次规划、0-1规划与混合整数规划、锥规划、双层规划、多目标规划、逆优化、分布式鲁棒优化、次模优化以及极小极大优化。我们采用基本统一的符号体系对模型进行规范化表示，并针对每一个应用，识别其输入、决策变量、主要公式表述、结构性质、求解策略与局限性。
tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的分类体系，将机器学习与人工智能中分散于各领域的应用归纳到共同的数学规划范式（线性、混合整数、双层、鲁棒优化等）之下，并用统一符号规范化每个应用的模型结构、求解策略与局限。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a unified taxonomy that organizes diverse machine learning and AI applications under common mathematical programming paradigms (linear, mixed-integer, bilevel, robust optimization, etc.), normalizing each application's inputs, decision variables, formulations, solution strategies, and limitations with consistent notation.
